title: AR/VR Developer
summary: An AR/VR developer builds apps where 3D content is laid over the real world (augmented reality, AR) or where users step into a virtual space (virtual reality, VR), usually in Unity or Unreal for phones and headsets such as Meta Quest. In India they mostly work in small XR studios or innovation teams, building training simulators, product demos and industrial apps with 3D artists and designers.
dailyDuties: Build AR and VR features in Unity or Unreal
Set up tracking, hand input and controller interactions
Bring 3D models and animations from artists into scenes
Profile and fix frame rate drops on headsets and phones
Test builds on devices such as Meta Quest and phones
Demo builds to clients and change them from feedback

skills.expectation: Build AR or VR apps with AR Foundation, ARKit, ARCore, OpenXR or the Meta XR SDK
Build XR apps in a real-time 3D engine
Build XR apps in a real-time 3D engine
Write engine code in C# (Unity) or C++ (Unreal)
Write engine code in C# (Unity) or C++ (Unreal)
Use 3D math for tracking, placement, physics and hand interactions
Profile and hold a steady frame rate on headsets and phones
Work in Git with designers and other developers
Design comfortable 3D interactions and menus for XR
Publish AR apps to the Play Store and App Store
Use image tracking or object detection in AR
Build multi-user sessions for training or collaboration
Build web AR with WebXR or Three.js
Connect XR apps to backend data or IoT feeds

certifications.why: Most XR work in India is built in Unity, and this proves Unity programming depth.
